body:
The original loader implementation from built-in CSS used a wrapped expression to evaluate whether to include `getClientStyleLoader()`:

```
ctx.isClient &&
  getClientStyleLoader({
    isDevelopment: ctx.isDevelopment,
    assetPrefix: ctx.assetPrefix,
  }),
```

This had to be filtered and use TS `as` in order to compile.

At: https://github.com/zeit/next.js/blob/canary/packages/next/build/webpack/config/blocks/css/index.ts#L215

The `unshift()` allows you to avoid both. I can mimic the original implementation if desired.
